source_interpretation: Five exact original function bodies per supported C provider separate borrowed definition argv, retained forward List, method option/name/formal/body source operations, info-level original frame List and procedure-method parameter validation. Source interpretation alone does not reveal the internal execution stop point of a failed public EvalObjv call. Initialized command-surface source excerpts remain distinct from public availability.
limits: ROW reads only original held public header/refcount/String-presence and reached callback counters; it does not ask any input String getter.

The original RESULT/PRESENTATION prefix can be followed by an updater EVENT on the same physical line, then result hex on the next line. Whole bytes remain authoritative. Derived presentation entries retain those physical lines, not a synthetic combined result/event.
method-returned is after public Tcl_EvalObjv, including any error-context rendering; an updated body at that point is not an independently observed body getter inside the rejected method worker.

Raw List member equality means the selected retained original object is present in that reported prefix/frame List; it supplies no command generation, namespace incarnation, active frame/entered source issuer or procedure identity.

The caller owns +1 on each custom original through interpreter teardown. Row/free/duplicate counts are for this held-original lifetime; custom free-representation callbacks are not allocation deallocation or command retirement.

Initialized C84/C85 command absence and the Jim public API/command unavailability channel are observed only for the measured initialized providers; no extension package was requested and no general absent-package conclusion follows.
All exact nine-case stages on C86/C90/C91 and genuine unavailability on C84/C85/Jim retain actual provider purpose. BIG-IP and Rust software outcomes are not measured.
